question: Explain SWOT analysis and its significance in strategic management.

points.label: Meaning
points.description: SWOT reviews internal Strengths and Weaknesses and external Opportunities and Threats.

points.label: Examples of each
points.description: Strengths and weaknesses relate to resources and capabilities; opportunities and threats come from markets, competition, technology and regulation.
points.basis: SWOT analysis: internal and external factors

points.label: Matching
points.description: It matches internal capabilities with the external environment to help formulate strategy.
points.basis: SWOT analysis: matching internal capabilities to the environment

points.label: Significance
points.description: It gives a logical framework to build on strengths, reduce weaknesses, exploit opportunities and counter threats.
points.basis: SWOT analysis: significance in strategy formulation
